notes.title: March 28th - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Disabled nanite for a performance boost on all graphics cards
 Added support for separate reload animations for short and long range
 Added new slide animations
 Fixed an issue with dust culling
 Significantly reduced projectiles available to alleviate the pressure that shooting is creating for players at all skill levels.

  Mag capacity for Long Range decreased 3 -> 2
  Projectiles stored capacity for Long Range 12 -> 6
  Projectiles stored capacity for Breaker Shot 12 -> 6

notes.title: March 20th 2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/01248404e99c93d74058afdd8b73fd0bd61f9807.png

...except when it's time to surrender :D

Here out lasted update for you to enjoy, deployed it yesterday, 20th of March 2025!


 Improved animations and models for several Strikers
 Fixed an issue when grappling hook ability and cosmic grab ability unintentionally interacted in some cases
 Added an option to forfeit the game if everyone on the team agrees
 Fixed an issue allowing players to perform a grab in some unintended ways while being slowed down
 Updated Audio to some skills and Voice Overs
 Updated visual effects on some Strikers' skills
 Added the option to choose which regions players can matchmake with


As usual join us on discord and let us know what you think of Vector Strike!

notes.title: March 11th 2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/f8cef579c539c397bfe0947fe65b478efeaa820f.jpg

Hello Strikers!

A patch has been deployed today! This update includes:

- New Ranks: Added Diamond, Elite, Titanium, Runic, Etherial, Astral, Legendary, and Striker
Apparently we can't keep you from climbing up to the ceiling so we added more ranked for you to show how good you are!

- Goal Celebration: Improved visuals
This is a first pass so that we can add a bit more spice after you score a goal. Moaar to come!

- Character Optimizations: Various performance and balance adjustments
This is part of our performance pass, my PC needs this!

- Environment and lighting optimizations
Same as above, more to come in the near future!

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Otto’s wall not displaying the correct destruction VFX.
- Added VFX to indicate the direction of the Magnus effect on the ball.
- French localization bug fixes

Also the name of Alex Kwon is correctly displayed in the Striker select in English. 
Dangeeer Zoooone!

notes.title: March 6th 2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi all, we deployed today a new patch with some fixes:

📽️  Show server region in client for online games

🌎  More fair region selection for mixed region matches

👀  Change visuals to Very Low as default settings for new players - we will do a push on performance in the near future - your saved setting should not change - we hear you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/87bcee000531dc94fb5fda2fb7fd464cbecb14ba.jpg

We also went through all your feedback and prioritize a few things for the next patch! Stay tune and keep telling us how you want the game to evolve!

notes.title: Shorter Goalcam! Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/55bf73fba93aa1718f6c69ad446d6c79af505d50.jpg

Thank you strikers for playing with us. We have a few fixes coming your way:

Deployed a hotfix solving several crashes:
crashes happening on CPUs from older generations
crashes happening on startup for certain accounts
Slimmed down match length including:
reducing goal camera to 8 seconds (was 12 seconds)
optimizing Best-of-Three game mode with having overtime only in the deciding round

Quality of life improvements:
Updated Strikers visuals in the character select screen
Updated Strikers portrait in the HUD
Juno model improvements
General performance improvements on the playing field
3rd person animation improvements on all characters (locomotion, jumping, shooting, gravity hold)

Don't forget to join Discord and give us feedback! See you on the pitch!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Creative Director Rawwwsome here to accompany you on Vector Strike’s first steps!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/cdc74c6ffa9e6114cc5c7d11daf2df733d9d7f61.jpg

The road so far…

Vector Strike has been in development for 18 months by a small team that wanted to do things differently. Today we welcome you to be part of our development team, and we can’t wait to see what you will do with the game mechanics at your disposal. Vector Strike has been built as a digital sport where you are the athlete and the protagonist. This is not a game where you move characters around like a football coach; this is a game where you will make all the choices and decide the outcome of your games.

Once you get in a game, you will be able to train in practice mode, queue up solo or with your friends, and get seeded for your rank after 10 matches.

Also, if you want to play against your friends, organize little tournaments or specific matches outside matchmaking, we have custom games available. In custom games, you can also join as a spectator and stream those games. Every game is captured in a replay where you can edit and share the best action, the best goals, and the most epic failures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/be6490e8a842b857a90c8dfe720b2850ec962439.jpg

We have five characters available for you. Four Strikers to master and play immediately, while Juno is unlockable after a few games. Our two prototype characters are locked for this demo. There are a lot of different ways to play with these Strikers and we are not enforcing any meta, you will have to discover the best way to play and ultimately win.

… is just the beginning!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/a5321ec5868610a7c8a009803d3f5c6a34f73bc8.jpg

This week's Steam Next Fest and Early access are our opportunity to keep developing this game with you. We have the next year planned ahead, with updates in all aspects of the game, from game design to tech, art, and animation. Expect more strikers and features that will make the game more solid, robust, and fun to play. But we are also allocating fifty percent of our time to prioritize things that are important to you and the community. The best way to communicate with us is through Discord, but don’t forget to use our form to report any bugs that you encounter. Vector Strike is all about potential: potential about the game, the team, and the community. This is our first step forward; join us, and together we can create something great.

From me and the entire team at Chamo Games, thank you for playing Vector Strike, and see you on the pitch!

notes.title: Free To Play Demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
OMG WE ARE SO EXCITED!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465974/8b5ff1601ec191095239b15ccbb22bdd12bb52f6.jpg

Starting February 24th, our servers will be up and running 24/7 across the globe for Steam Next Fest. The demo will be available to install from our store page on the same day, and everything will go live as soon as the event starts at 10:00 AM Pacific Time / 7:00 PM Central European Time.

During Next Fest, you'll have the opportunity to play with all our released champions, including the amazing Juno, who will be unlockable after just a few games!

Additionally, if you play 10 matches, you'll earn your rank and can begin your climb to the pinnacle of esports!

And After Steam Next Fest... Early Access!

As soon as Steam Next Fest concludes on March 3rd, we’ll fire up the engines of this spaceship and launch into Early Access! We’ll publish patch notes detailing all the new features coming to the game and share our roadmap so you’ll have a clear idea of what’s ahead. We’re committed to making this game absolutely awesome!

If you have any questions, comments, opinions, or requests, please feel free to join our Discord and share your ideas!

From all of us at Chamo Games, thank you for being part of this journey. Let’s goooooooooooo!
